svg.title: The limitations are part of the contract
svg.desc: M3.1 solves the delivery/feedback seams only for explicitly selected new profiles and fresh journals. Disposable copies of populated old stores reject the selection with UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE and remain replayable under old profiles. Existing user stores are not migrated or repaired. Pending feedback need not converge: eligible effects are not newly applied by reconciliation, unavailable/malformed replies stay pending, and bounded tombstone/command capacity can exhaust. Unresolved derivation attempts use original step recovery, not reconciliation; lost reservations are not reclaimed. No exactly-one physical computation, hard real-time, power-loss, administrator secrecy, distributed failover, production throughput or cognitive-quality claim. Origin/independence remain operator assumptions. Specialist maintainer assignments remain open.
svg.text: 04 / GUARANTEES AND STOPPING POINT
The limitations are part of the contract
Accurate closure can still report pending work. No state migration is implied.
Conservative crash budget
A lost pending attempt consumes its slot.
Reconciliation never refunds or starts new
inference.
Finite closure capacity
Eligible or unavailable feedback stays
pending. Full command / cause journals are
not evicted.
Fresh profiles, fresh journals
Old M3 pending work cannot be repaired here.
Old stores reject the new profile and retain old
replay.
Local recovery evidence
Same host, cooperative clock, intact files and
trusted operator. Power loss and distributed
failover unrun.
Stopped at M3.1: no new cognition, scheduler, ECAN, LTI, search, migration or chain work.
